description: This file contains unit tests for the {@link AbstractRequestResponseClient} class. It verifies functionalities such as request creation, message sending, response handling, caching behavior, timeout handling, and credit management within the client implementation.

classes.name: AbstractRequestResponseClient
classes.description: An abstract class for a request-response client using Proton messaging in Vert.x, managing message creation, sending, response handling, caching, and timeout mechanisms.

methods.name: createAndSendRequest
methods.description: Creates and sends a request message with specified parameters, setting up response handlers and timeout handling.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Processes an incoming message as a response, matching it to the correct request based on correlation ID.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a one-way request message, handling acceptance or rejection from the peer.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the current credit available on the sender link.
